ordinary_algorithm.rule: CoreKey creates eight keys, ST7 sets macro SENPILL override true. Fresh instance bytes start zero; SENPIR/AUX flags and copy-while-pinned byte are false.

Apps and eight secondary bits load before raw block groups/values, then GetKeyBlocks reads each mask as eight ascending bits and appends ascending block references. Ordinary AddBlock itself does not evict other keys.

GetPrimaryBlock returns reference item0 when nonempty, otherwise nil. Initial masks therefore select least-set-bit. PrimaryGroup is that block object only when reference count equals1; multi/zero masks project nil.

Singleton raw group255 resolves through the application-owned manager create=True and remains the per-application unused object(app,255). Same-app255 shares pointer; different apps differ; nil differs from any unused object.

Set key template16 before locking MacroFunctionPin; load four unsigned nibble commands through wire factory under that pin; unlock; fill empty subset name from unit; MacroFunctionRefresh(false). Every raw0..15 wire enum is identity.

Factory scans appended templates and each template groups in registration order and stops at first exact JP/SR/LP/LR match. Four-stage overload compares source type only if inputSource argument is nonzero; ordinary loader passes false=0, so no input-source filtering and no VC/VT comparison. Six-stage registration aliases MC/MT/OC/OT to JP/SR/LP/LR through sensor2/3/0/1. Fifty valid nibble tuples match;65486 use fallback26/group56. No family4 is admitted by raw0..15.

With a primary block, macro14 becomes17/18/20 iff Store1 is249/252/255. Macro15 becomes19/22 iff Store2 is2/5. Other values keep14/15; no primary means no variant.

RefreshTemplateFromMacroFunction holds MacroFunctionPin. SENLLA primary/secondary Lighting subset is[16,0..13,34,17..24,26]. Any absent derived template becomes keytemplate26; raw microfunctions remain unchanged under the pin.

After MacroFunctionRefresh, GetKeyValues assigns indicator BlockNumber=raw IndicatorBlockAssignment+1 and default Scene1. Class indicator allocation enabled/non-slaved.

Conflict categoriesA={17},B={18,19},C={20,21,22}, equality of PrimaryGroup object including nil==nil; incompatible later siblings become template16 through unlocked setter and their four stages become0. Fresh combo selection itself is display-only; raw indicator assignment remains.

SetKeyBlocks rebuilds eight masks from actual references. SetKeyValues writes SceneKeySelector0, each indicator BlockNumber-1, and each microfunction internalenum&127 as numeric commands.
